name: impatience
description: A desired experience is delayed by people or things not acting as quickly as expected.

variations.name: impatience with people
variations.description: A desired experience is being unnecessarily slowed by someone or a group.
examples: The checkout clerk was unbelievably slow.

variations.name: self impatience
variations.description: A sense that there must be something wrong with your own abilities for making such slow progress towards a desired experience.

variations.name: existential impatience
variations.description: A desired experience is perceived as being slowed by the unfair nature of the universe.
examples: The child was impatient to grow up.

variations.name: impatience to feel better
variations.description: The desired experience is to be healthy or pain free, but the body is taking longer than expected to heal.

commentaries.quote: We are prediction machines, so impatience is partly driven by the discomfort of having to face that a prediction was too optimistic.
Impatience can cause wise people to do foolish things.

conditions: A desire for a certain experience and a sense of being significantly slowed from reaching that experience by something unexpected.
